status: Retained native-handoff and aggregation repair: final DRC/consumer validation and capability cost gates pass. The complete properties.md goal remains active.
scope: Remove implicit PCB native access, preserve supported native carriers during aggregation, and retain required net-length measurement failures.

baseline_result.note: Seven failures independently reproduced with production sources at the recorded revision. Exhausted profile construction already retained its failure and is preserved as a passing baseline control.

contract: PcbRegion no longer implements Deref or DerefMut. try_area and try_is_empty evaluate under STRICT with source and shared-exhaustion checks, and unavailable area is a typed error. All in-workspace native-query call sites use explicit checked operations; a compile-fail doctest prevents implicit filled_area access.

try_into_native and Polygon::try_exact_region are named checked handoffs. They validate retained source failures and the current shared budget; subsequent exported/borrowed native operations use the caller policy. They do not attach future PCB guards to the native carrier.
replace_native keeps metadata but clears old source facts, failures, bounds and component/report caches. Existing clones retain their old carrier, views and failures.

Profile aggregation validates every source under STRICT. A singleton shares the source Arc without requiring a line/arc adapter. Multiple line/arc inputs retain the bulk native contour path; mixed supported families use balanced native regularized union. Failed construction remains attached to the owner and blocks checked queries; callers retry construction from source polygons in a fresh scope.

Authored report decomposition and samples are retained; geometry is independent of those coordinates. Quadratic disjoint/overlap/duplicate/containment fixtures retain exact areas 4/3, 7/3, 5/3 and 2 as applicable.

Net-class length and differential length proxies share checked native endpoint-span/envelope measurement. Extraction, root, ordering, source and budget failures cannot become absent/zero measurements. Failed contributions block partial net and pair sums while recording geometry-uncertainty.
Readiness implementation version is 5; schema remains 1. Six Easyduino expected snapshots change only version fields, preserving all finding rows and expected counts.

validation.extended_existing_test: Unsupported degree-five rational-cap area now also checks the public PCB typed-area boundary.

consumer_validation.scope: All six Easyduino fast-DRC boards, one impedance unit and two consumer smoke tests selected by the hyperdrc filter, plus five curved-outline tests. This is not the complete HyperCircuit suite. Version fields alone change from 4 to 5; finding rows/counts and full fixtures remain unchanged. All HyperCircuit and HyperDRC Rust source hashes are retained for this final consumer chain.

cost.limitations: Five sequential fresh processes and one full fixture run pinned to CPU 0 after every build/test exits. Region rows measure the operation plus checked result bounds, using fixed warm inputs and new PCB output wrappers; internal native-kernel evidence may already be warm. Input construction, first/last exact area and report-coordinate fingerprint checks are outside query timers but inside process RSS. Classification, bounds, area and emptiness rows each time one checked query; native handoff times a wrapper clone plus checked consuming export. Single/mixed aggregation and replacement rows also query checked result bounds. Fourteen witness rows and serialized bytes are identical across all five trials. The full two-board and Gerber fixture workload and its 120-second gate are unchanged. These are candidate capability costs; no matched speedup, allocation count or library-size delta is claimed.

draft.migration_compilation: draft/migration-compilation.log retains initial Arc coercion, stale test API and unused import errors; all were fixed before final DRC validation.
draft.focused: draft/focused-eight.log and draft/focused-seventeen.log retain the two successful focused stages.
draft.consumer_migration: draft/consumer-migration retains the initial consumer Clippy failure from one curved-outline test using removed is_empty. That consumer-only test was migrated; DRC production sources were unchanged. The complete consumer chain was rerun successfully.

replay.conditions: Run from repository root with fresh output directories. Baseline replay needs a separate clean checkout of the recorded production commit and restores its temporary regression files. Candidate cost runs must wait until all builds/tests exit; the cost script builds the library/probe first.

remaining: All 39 properties, all 14 targets and crate-specific future work remain in scope. No whole property or full HyperDRC certification is claimed.

Polygon area Option/filter_map consumers and report-area filtering still need required-failure propagation. Admitting native higher-order geometry does not certify every readiness consumer: some native area integrals remain unavailable and legacy callers can still discard them. This is the next required integration repair.

Remaining scalar-threshold decisions (including net-class limit selection/comparison), finite source-coordinate/radius adapters, spatial heuristics and affine construction/budget boundaries still require audit.
Native pad/track/slot/custom geometry and general kernel compositions remain incomplete. Kernel blockers are retained; display chords never supply the new aggregation path.
Endpoint-span and envelope dimensions are readiness proxies, not proofs of routed-path length, physical trace width or impedance.
Shared guards reject known exhausted scopes but do not establish total runtime, memory or precision bounds.
The complete repository pre-push matrix has not run; no push is requested or made.
